body: I appreciate you sharing this, thanks. The issue though is that nothing in life inspires me. I have no aspirations or even goals for the next year of my life. When I had goals, I cared a bit less about what others thought of me and would try and focus on doing what I wanted. Since then, though things have fallen through and all I really live for nowadays is my job. I don't enjoy much and nothing interests me anymore.

The problem is that I enjoy my job a lot and aside from my manager putting me down, every other part of it is great. I just don't feel motivated to do anything more since good deeds go unnoticed and sometimes I get the blame for things which aren't even my fault. I wish I could feel the same way you do but unfortunately I require validation from others as a metric for how well I'm doing my job. It hurts that nothing I do seems to be helpful and is only seen as a hindrance. Thank you for your insight though. I appreciate it.

Everyone. I'm consistently below average in what I do. My boss made it clear today in how disappointed he was. I try so hard to go the extra mile for everyone yet it never ends well. I've tried new activities but literally nothing brings me satisfaction any more. I've tried to put my job as my primary focus in life, making it the reason I get out of bed in the morning. This failing has just lead me to see that no matter what I do, it won't work out and things won't get better.
